name: Grilled Marinated Chicken Breast with Steamed Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
whyItWorks: Tender skinless chicken breast marinated lightly in herbs and olive oil, grilled over open flame and served with fluffy white rice. Extremely gentle on sensitive intestinal mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for chicken simply grilled without blackened spices or heavy butter sauces. Pair with steamed rice and skip raw salad.
